title: RPG-OS Ruleset
description: Schema for a RPG-OS ruleset file. The ruleset defines the schema (rules) of one game system; the engine resolves them in universal (dynamic) mode or via generated (specific) code. Every ruleset must state its licence and may carry an optional comment. Numeric data values may be expressed as a plain integer, a dice expression string (e.g. "2d6+1"), or a range object {"min": ..., "max": ...}; the engine picks such values per a requested variance (weakest / weak / average / strong / strongest / random).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema. Currently always 1.

source.description: Source document the rules were transcribed from.

licence.description: REQUIRED. Licence governing the ruleset content (e.g. 'CC-BY-4.0'), or a statement for proprietary sources.

comment.description: Optional free-form note by the ruleset author.

namespace.description: C++ namespace the code generator emits into.

spell_resource.description: Optional: the resource pool id that casting a spell draws its cost from (e.g. 'AE' for astral energy). When set, the engine's castSpell spends a spell's cost automatically; empty means spells have no resource cost in this ruleset.

currencies.description: Optional coinage. A ruleset without this section has no money; the engine then refuses money operations with UnknownCurrency. The base unit is the smallest coin and every denomination declares how many base units it is worth.

symbol.description: e.g. 'GP'. Price strings match this symbol.

per_base.description: How many base units one of this coin is worth (e.g. 100 for a D&D gold piece with copper base).

encumbrance.description: Optional carrying rules. The capacity is a formula over stats (e.g. '15 * STR'); levels map carried/capacity ratios to a condition applied to the carrier. Without this section the engine reports no carrying limit.

weight_unit.description: Unit used by item 'weight' fields, e.g. 'lb'.

default_weight.description: Fallback weight for items without a 'weight' field.

capacity.description: Capacity formula over stats, e.g. '15 * STR'.

max_ratio.description: Carried/capacity ratio ceiling for this level (0..).

condition.description: Condition applied at this level ('' = none).

spellcasting.description: Optional casting configuration. 'pool' (default) charges a per-spell cost from the spell_resource pool; 'slots' uses a vancian per-day schedule keyed by spell level.

slots.description: Vancian schedule: spell level -> slots per day.

name.description: Human name used to derive C++ identifiers.

formula.description: Restricted grammar: arithmetic (+ - * / % ^), comparisons, && || !, min/max/floor/ceil/round/clamp, and identifiers (attribute ids, actor.*, target.*, env.*, parameters). Must be translatable to C++ by the code generator.

max_stat.description: Stat id whose value forms the pool's maximum.

check_types.description: Named checks keyed by check type id. Each entry is a generic, data-driven CheckRecipe (see core/checks.hpp): the engine knows no ruleset-specific mechanism, so a new game system is expressed purely as new recipe JSON. The recipe's resolution picks the fundamental shape; the other fields configure dice, comparison, reference source, criticals, grading, and difficulty handling.

description.description: Optional human note (ignored by the engine).

resolution.description: threshold: one roll vs one reference. pool: independent rolls whose overshoot draws on a pool. opposed: attacker vs defender contest. resistance: one roll vs a chance derived from two stats.

comparison.description: ge: the (bonus-adjusted) roll must be >= the reference (additive checks). le: the roll must be <= the reference (roll-under checks).

threshold_source.description: Where the reference comes from: the CheckParams difficulty, an actor stat, or a target stat.

threshold_stat.description: Stat id used by threshold_source actor_stat/target_stat.

bonus_stats.description: Actor stats added to the rolled total (additive checks).

pool_attributes.description: Pool resolution: the attributes each independent roll is checked against.

pool_stat.description: Pool resolution: the stat providing the pool.

compare_levels.description: Opposed: true compares graded success levels (a hit needs a strictly higher level); false resolves a staged roll-under contest (parry only after a successful attack).

critical_style.description: Critical success detection: face (a specific die face), double (two equal dice), percentile (graded bands), none.

critical_face.description: critical_style face: the die face that is a critical.

critical_confirm.description: critical_style face: re-roll to confirm the critical.

fumble_style.description: Critical failure detection (same shapes as critical_style).

fumble_face.description: fumble_style face: the die face that is a fumble.

fumble_confirm.description: fumble_style face: re-roll to confirm the fumble.

grading.description: How much information the result carries: none, graded percentile success levels, or a quality level from the remaining pool.

difficulty_mode.description: How CheckParams.difficulty is applied: to_threshold means it IS the reference (a fixed DC); to_stat adds it to the stat forming the reference.

difficulty_multiplier.description: Whether Easy / Difficult scales the reference multiplicatively (double_halve).

amount.description: consume_resource: amount to spend; gain_item/remove_item: item quantity; gain_currency/spend_currency: base-unit amount; gain_xp: XP amount.

stacks.description: Stack count, or a formula string evaluated at runtime.

data.description: The data database: archetypes, items, creatures, spells, conditions, poisons, diseases. All numeric values may be ranges.

effects.description: Optional structured effects (the machine-readable form of the spell's prose: saves, half-on-save damage, conditions, healing, resistances). When present, the engine resolves these instead of the bare damage field.

max_stacks.description: Optional cap on the stack count.

stat_modifiers.description: Optional mechanical effects: each entry modifies a stat, scaled by the condition's stack count. Same shape as item modifiers but with 'stat' instead of 'target_stat'.

curses.description: Optional curses: same record shape as poisons/diseases (save + effects + duration), applied via the engine's applyAffliction('curses', ...) and curable.

damage_modifier.description: BRP damage modifier table: STR+SIZ ranges to the damage-modifier dice (e.g. '2 to 12' -> '-1D6').

sorcery_spells.description: Reference list of sorcery spells from the handout, categorized (Augmentation, Characteristic, Combat, Enhancement, Elemental, Manipulative, Occult, Summoning, Utility), with the level range each spell costs 1 power point per level.

psychic_abilities.description: Reference list of psychic abilities from the handout; each costs a minimum of 1 power point to use.

superpowers.description: Reference list of superpowers from the handout.

mutations.description: Random mutation table from the handout (roll D100); adverse mutations are flagged.

chaotic_features.description: Chaotic Features table from the handout: optional features for demons and other creatures of chaos.

fumble_tables.description: Combat fumble tables from the handout (natural weapon attack/parry, melee weapon attack/parry, missile weapon attack), keyed by table name.

major_wounds.description: Major Wound table from the handout; consulted when a character suffers a major wound.

personality_traits.description: Personality trait pairs from the handout; the value of the opposite trait is 100 minus the initial trait.

reputation.description: Reputation gains list and observer modifiers from the handout.

sanity.description: Sanity reference tables from the handout: temporary insanity and its duration.

variantValue.description: A numeric value that may be a plain integer, a dice expression string, or an explicit range object.

attackDef.description: An attack roll the source makes against the target (spell attacks, breath-weapon attack lines, ...). The source rolls `dice` (default 1d20), adds each stat id in `bonus_stats` (resolved on the source, e.g. the ability `_mod` plus `proficiency_bonus`), and hits when the total is >= the target's `target_stat`. On a hit the damage (or condition) applies; on a miss it is reduced per `on_miss`.

bonus_stats.description: Stat ids (resolved on the attacking entity) added to the roll, e.g. ["CHA_mod", "proficiency_bonus"].

target_stat.description: The target's defensive stat used as the threshold (default 'AC').

on_miss.description: none (default): a miss applies nothing; half: a miss applies half the damage.

saveDef.description: A saving throw a target makes against an effect. The target rolls `dice` (default 1d20), adds its `stat`, and succeeds when the total is >= the DC. The DC is a fixed number or a formula over the acting entity's (the caster's) stats, e.g. '8 + 2 + max(0, floor((INT - 10) / 2))'.

stat.description: The stat the target adds to the roll.

dc.description: Fixed DC, or a formula over the acting entity's stats.

on_success.description: half: halve the damage on a successful save; none (default): the effect does not apply.

effectRecord.description: One structured, machine-readable rule effect (the extracted form of a prose rule). The engine resolves these automatically. Kinds: damage (with an optional save), condition (with an optional save), heal, and resist.

add.description: heal/temp_hp: a flat amount (or a formula over the acting entity's stats) added to the rolled dice.

condition.description: condition: the condition id to apply.

types.description: resist: damage types the target becomes resistant to.

save.description: Optional saving throw the target must fail for the effect to apply (damage: on_success 'half' halves it).

attack.description: Optional attack roll the source makes against the target (alternative to a save). On a hit the damage/condition applies; a miss applies nothing (or half damage for damage effects).

slot.description: Item-only: the equipment slot this item fits (e.g. 'weapon_hand'); empty when it is not worn.

weight.description: Item-only: weight, e.g. '2 lb.' or a number in the encumbrance weight unit.

value.description: Item-only: price, e.g. '150 GP' or a number in base currency units.

price.description: Cost of a single dose, e.g. '150 GP'.

stat.description: The stat, resource pool, or condition id this effect acts on. A resource pool id damages that pool; a condition id (or the explicit 'condition' field) applies condition stacks; any other stat id is reduced by amount.

condition.description: When stat is not itself a condition id, the condition id to apply (amount = stacks).
